title: Dutch–Ahanta War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Dutch–Ahanta War", at revision 1370616064, opens: "The Dutch–Ahanta War was a conflict between the Netherlands and the Ahanta between 1837 and 1839. Beginning with a mere economic dispute between the Ahanta and the Dutch, who were based at the Dutch Gold Coast, the conflict ended with the hanging of Ahanta king Badu Bonsu II and the reorganization of the Ahanta state, establishing a Dutch protectorate over the Ahanta." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5317509, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
